evidence: Mechanistically grounded projection. Text-only autoscalers (incl. disaggregated ones like HeteroScale/TokenScale) watch signals derived from the request/token stream; even per-stage token velocities are that one stream split by phase. The trace-eda evidence shows the vision pool's demand (images/s: CV^2=3.83, ACF half-life 69min, Hurst ~0.93) is far burstier and more persistent than, and decorrelated from, the request stream (requests/s CV^2=0.32, half-life 9min). A controller blind to that signal must size the vision pool off request rate, reproducing the order-of-magnitude missizing the thesis quantifies (encoder 2->8 workers across windows). The mechanism (signal carries almost no vision-pool information -> off-signal sizing missizes) is directly evidenced, though this is an inference rather than a literal replay of those autoscalers on the split workload.
